basic_details.job_title: DCPU Chengalpattu Watchman Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: District Child Protection Unit (DCPU) has published the Watchman Notification 2026 on its official website. The recruitment drive aims to fill 1 Watchman position on a contractual basis. Candidates between 21 and 42 years of age who have passed the 8th Standard are eligible to apply. Interested candidates can submit their offline applications on or before 11 August 2026. The official notification PDF and application form are available on the respective District Child Protection Unit's official website.

application_fee.details: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

age_limit.details: Minimum Age: 21 years Maximum Age: 42 years

selection_process: Please refer to the official notification for selection process details.
how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for DCPU Chengalpattu காவலாளி (Watchman) Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: http://chengalpattu.nic.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 11-08-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DCPU Chengalpattu Watchman recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the Watchman post is 11 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum qualification required for the Watchman post?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification required for the Watchman post is 8th Pass.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Watchman position?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 21 and 42 years of age to be eligible for the Watchman post.

faq.question: Q4. How will the candidates be selected for the Watchman post?
faq.answer: The selection process details are not explicitly mentioned in the provided data. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for complete information.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Watchman post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 548/- per day.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for the DCPU Chengalpattu Watchman recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is strictly offline. Candidates need to download the form and submit it via post or in person.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of the District Child Protection Unit, Chengalpattu: http://chengalpattu.nic.in.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required to be submitted with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach copies of relevant certificates, family card, Aadhaar card, experience certificate, and photographs with their application.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job is on a contract basis.
